circuit.name: 5t-ota
circuit.rationale: Only itail fails (153 uA). Halving tail-device width at fixed vbias scales tail current linearly to ~77 uA. Pair gm drops only ~sqrt(2)-ish (moderate inversion), so GBW falls to ~25-30 MHz, still >20 MHz; gain rises with ro, phase margin keeps ample headroom.
